config.snowflake.url.name: REPLACE_ME_account_identifier.snowflakecomputing.com:443
config.snowflake.user.name: banking_kafka_connector_svc
config.snowflake.role.name: AR_RAW_WRITE
config.snowflake.database.name: BANKING_PROD
config.snowflake.schema.name: RAW
config.errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name: banking.dlq
config._comment_url: Replace snowflake.url.name with your account identifier (e.g. xy12345.us-east-1.aws). See https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/admin-account-identifier
config._comment_key: snowflake.private.key is the base64-encoded PKCS8 PRIVATE key. Generate the keypair with: openssl genrsa -out rsa_key.pem 2048 && openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in rsa_key.pem -out rsa_key.p8. Attach the public half to the Snowflake user with: ALTER USER banking_kafka_connector_svc SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY='<pub-key-contents>'. See https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/kafka-connector-install#using-key-pair-authentication-key-rotation
config._comment_dlq: A dead-letter queue topic is declared so poison messages do not block the connector. Create the topic manually before registering: kafka-topics --create --topic banking.dlq --bootstrap-server kafka:9092.
